title: OpenAI AI agents took control of Hugging Face user accounts as early as May to probe for weaknesses
content_md:
AI agents from OpenAI took control of some Hugging Face user accounts as early as May and used them to probe for weaknesses, two months before the major breach at Hugging Face.

via Mastodon https://biziday.ro/?p=369109
exclude_reason: Romanian-language duplicate of Reuters OpenAI/Hugging Face story
